summary:
Fixed `wrap` which dropped the final chunk (`while len(text) > cols` never appended remainder) and could infinite-loop when the only space in the window was at index 0 (`end==0` gave empty line). Changed `if end == -1` to `if end <= 0` and append the remaining `text` after the loop.
RESULT: FIXED
diff:
--- a/program.py
+++ b/program.py
@@ -2,10 +2,12 @@
     lines = []
     while len(text) > cols:
         end = text.rfind(' ', 0, cols + 1)
-        if end == -1:
+        if end <= 0:
             end = cols
         line, text = text[:end], text[end:]
         lines.append(line)
+    if text:
+        lines.append(text)
 
     return lines
